nodes.name: htmlpreelement.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the HTMLPreElement DOM interface for `<pre>` (preformatted text) elements, supporting the `width` attribute with integer parsing.

nodes.name: HTMLPreElement
nodes.summary: DOM struct representing a `<pre>` element, wrapping HTMLElement with width attribute support via parse_plain_attribute.

nodes.name: htmlprogresselement.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the HTMLProgressElement DOM interface for `<progress>` elements, managing a shadow DOM progress bar with value/max/position calculations.

nodes.name: HTMLProgressElement
nodes.summary: DOM struct representing `<progress>`, managing value/max attributes and shadow tree state for the progress bar UI.

nodes.name: ShadowTree
nodes.summary: Internal struct holding handles to the UA shadow tree progress bar element.

nodes.name: create_shadow_tree
nodes.summary: Creates the UA shadow DOM for the progress element, building a progress bar with appropriate styling and ARIA attributes.

nodes.name: Value
nodes.summary: Getter for the current value of the progress bar, defaulting to 0 if not set.

nodes.name: Max
nodes.summary: Getter for the maximum value of the progress bar, defaulting to 1 if not set.

nodes.name: Position
nodes.summary: Calculates the current progress position as a ratio of value to max, returning 0 for indeterminate state.

nodes.name: attribute_mutated
nodes.summary: Handles attribute changes on the progress element, updating the shadow DOM bar width when value/max change.

nodes.name: htmlquoteelement.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the HTMLQuoteElement DOM interface for `<q>` and `<blockquote>` elements, providing the `cite` attribute via IDL bindings.

nodes.name: HTMLQuoteElement
nodes.summary: DOM struct representing `<q>` and `<blockquote>` elements with cite attribute support.

nodes.name: htmlscriptelement.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the HTMLScriptElement DOM interface, handling script loading, preparation, execution, and lifecycle management per the HTML spec.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the full script lifecycle: classic/module script fetching, CSP enforcement, render-blocking, trusted types, import maps, and external script kind classification.

nodes.name: HTMLScriptElement
nodes.summary: Main DOM struct for `<script>` elements with state tracking for script preparation, execution modes, and render-blocking behavior.

nodes.name: ScriptType
nodes.summary: Enum classifying whether a script is a classic script or a module.

nodes.name: Script
nodes.summary: Internal representation of a loaded script with its text content, metadata, and association with a module tree.

nodes.name: ClassicContext
nodes.summary: Manages the context for a list of classic scripts prepared during document parsing, tracking ready-to-execute scripts.

nodes.name: ExternalScriptKind
nodes.summary: Enum classifying external script loading priority: ASAP, deferred, parsing-blocking, or in-order-asap.

nodes.name: get_script_kind
nodes.summary: Determines the external script kind based on async/defer attributes and parser insertion state.

nodes.name: finish_fetching_a_script
nodes.summary: Handles post-fetch processing: validates content-type, sets the script text, and prepares the script for execution.

nodes.name: process_response
nodes.summary: Processes the HTTP response for a classic script fetch, handling redirects and MIME type validation.

nodes.name: process_response_eof
nodes.summary: Finalizes a classic script fetch by decoding the response body and invoking the fetch completion callback.

nodes.name: prepare
nodes.summary: Implements the core script preparation algorithm from the HTML spec: determines script type, fetches or uses inline text, and queues execution.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Executes a prepared script by running the classic or module script in the appropriate JS realm.

nodes.name: get_script_type
nodes.summary: Determines if a script is javascript, module, or another type based on the type attribute value per the HTML spec.

nodes.name: attribute_mutated
nodes.summary: Handles attribute mutations on the script element, reacting to src/type/async/defer changes.

nodes.name: children_changed
nodes.summary: Handles changes to the script element's child text content, updating the script text for inline scripts.

nodes.name: cloning_steps
nodes.summary: Manages the cloning behavior for script elements, resetting state for the cloned copy.

nodes.name: SetSrc
nodes.summary: Setter for the `src` attribute that triggers fetching of an external script when the element is already connected.

nodes.name: Blocking
nodes.summary: Getter for the `blocking` DOMTokenList attribute that controls render-blocking behavior.

nodes.name: SetInnerText
nodes.summary: Setter for `innerText` on script elements that delegates to the default implementation but ensures the text is set as script content.

nodes.name: SetText
nodes.summary: Setter for the `text` IDL attribute of script elements, synchronizing both content and script text.

nodes.name: SetTextContent
nodes.summary: Setter for `textContent` that updates the script's internal script text to match the new content.

nodes.name: substitute_with_local_script
nodes.summary: Handles automatic substitution of a locally-available script (e.g., import map) avoiding a network fetch.

nodes.name: htmlselectelement.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the HTMLSelectElement DOM interface for `<select>` dropdown lists, managing options, shadow DOM rendering, form integration, and validation.

nodes.name: HTMLSelectElement
nodes.summary: Main DOM struct for `<select>` elements with option list management, shadow DOM, form control logic, and embedder-driven popup menus.

nodes.name: ShadowTree
nodes.summary: Internal struct holding references to UA shadow DOM elements for the select widget rendering.

nodes.name: OptionsFilter
nodes.summary: Filter implementation for iterating over descendant option elements.

nodes.name: list_of_options
nodes.summary: Builds the list of HTMLOptionElement descendants, filtering out disabled optgroup options per spec.

nodes.name: create_shadow_tree
nodes.summary: Creates the UA shadow DOM for the select element with a styled container, text display, and chevron indicator.

nodes.name: show_menu
nodes.summary: Requests the embedder to show the native dropdown menu and handles the embedder response for option selection.

nodes.name: handle_embedder_response
nodes.summary: Processes the embedder's response after a menu selection, updating the selected option and notifying listeners.

nodes.name: multiple_attribute_mutated
nodes.summary: Handles the `multiple` attribute changing by rebuilding the shadow tree and resetting selection state.

nodes.name: send_update_notifications
nodes.summary: Fires change and input events when the select element's value changes, handling batching and event dispatch.

nodes.name: SetValue
nodes.summary: Sets the select element's selected value by finding the matching option and updating selection state.

nodes.name: SetSelectedIndex
nodes.summary: Sets the selected index of the select element, handling single and multiple selection modes.

nodes.name: attribute_mutated
nodes.summary: Handles attribute changes, triggering shadow tree updates and size recalculation.

nodes.name: htmlslotelement.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the HTMLSlotElement DOM interface for `<slot>` elements in shadow DOM, managing slottable node assignment and slotchange events.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the shadow DOM slotting algorithm: finding slottables, assigning nodes, signaling slot changes, and manual slot assignment.

nodes.name: HTMLSlotElement
nodes.summary: DOM struct for `<slot>` elements, tracking assigned nodes and manual slot assignment state.

nodes.name: Slottable
nodes.summary: Enum representing a node that can be assigned to a slot (Element or Text).

nodes.name: SlottableData
nodes.summary: Internal struct tracking a slottable node's assigned slot and manual assignment cache.

nodes.name: AssignedNodes
nodes.summary: Returns the nodes assigned to this slot, optionally flattening to include fallback content when no nodes are assigned.

nodes.name: Assign
nodes.summary: Manually assigns nodes to a slot, replacing any previously manually assigned nodes per the imperative slot API.

nodes.name: find_flattened_slottables
nodes.summary: Finds all nodes that should be assigned to this slot by traversing the flattened shadow tree, handling slot chains.

nodes.name: find_slottables
nodes.summary: Implements the slotting algorithm: finds which nodes in a shadow tree should be assigned to a given slot by name or fallback.

nodes.name: assign_slottables
nodes.summary: Assigns a set of nodes to a slot, updating the assigned nodes list and notifying the node of its assigned slot.

nodes.name: signal_a_slot_change
nodes.summary: Queues a slotchange event for this slot if not already queued, coordinating with the agent's signal slot set.

nodes.name: find_a_slot
nodes.summary: Finds the appropriate slot for a node by checking slot name attributes in the parent shadow root.

nodes.name: attribute_mutated
nodes.summary: Handles `name` attribute changes on a slot, triggering reassignment of slottable nodes and a slotchange event.

nodes.name: htmlsourceelement.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the HTMLSourceElement DOM interface for `<source>` elements within `<picture>` and `<audio>`/`<video>` parents, managing media attribute changes.

nodes.name: HTMLSourceElement
nodes.summary: DOM struct for `<source>` elements, handling attribute mutation and parent media/picture element notifications.

nodes.name: attribute_mutated
nodes.summary: Notifies the parent `<picture>` or `<media>` element when media-related attributes change, triggering resource re-evaluation.

nodes.name: bind_to_tree
nodes.summary: Notifies the parent `<picture>` element when the source is inserted into the DOM tree.

nodes.name: unbind_from_tree
nodes.summary: Notifies the parent `<picture>` element when the source is removed from the DOM tree.

nodes.name: htmlspanelement.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the HTMLSpanElement DOM interface for `<span>` elements, a simple inline container with no additional attributes beyond HTMLElement.

nodes.name: HTMLSpanElement
nodes.summary: DOM struct for `<span>` elements, a minimal wrapper around HTMLElement with no custom behavior.

nodes.name: htmlstyleelement.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the HTMLStyleElement DOM interface for `<style>` elements, managing CSS stylesheet creation, ownership, media queries, and render-blocking.

nodes.name: HTMLStyleElement
nodes.summary: DOM struct for `<style>` elements with stylesheet management, parser insertion tracking, and render-blocking support.

nodes.name: update_a_style_block
nodes.summary: Core implementation that updates the style block content, parsing CSS, handling CSP checks, and replacing the stylesheet. This is the main logic for inline style changes.

nodes.name: create_owned_contents_stylesheet
nodes.summary: Creates a stylesheet from the element's text content, handling URL resolution, media queries, and CSS parsing.

nodes.name: clean_stylesheet_ownership
nodes.summary: Clears the association between the element and its stylesheet when the element is destroyed or the sheet is replaced.

nodes.name: attribute_mutated
nodes.summary: Handles CSS-related attribute changes (media, blocking, nonce, integrity), triggering style block updates.

nodes.name: load_finished
nodes.summary: Called when a CSS load completes, tracking pending loads and finalizing the stylesheet update.
